summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in animate-tailwind-kit@3.0.1
details: The package animate-tailwind-kit@3.0.1 contains 8 files and shows no evidence of installer-facing threat behavior. No lifecycle scripts fetching or executing remote content were observed, no reads of installer credential paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser profiles) or environment scraping, no hardcoded exfiltration endpoints, no obfuscated payloads, and no silent-relay of caller-supplied data. Behavior is consistent with a small Tailwind CSS animation utility package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
